integrity: The proof is finite-graph reasoning valid for every positive integer q; a standalone exhaustive small-instance program provides corroboration, not an infinite certificate. The literature comparison does not establish an exhaustive priority search.
scientific_limitations: Classification and census apply to individually named parameter sets of cardinality divisible by three. The optimal numerical bound and a general achieving construction were established in arXiv:2607.16889v1. This result classifies distinct labelled trace families rather than ambient host graph isomorphism types. Exact historical priority and independent mathematical verification remain open.
title: Cayley-tree census of equality-case unary neighbourhood types in finite forests
